steps.title: Prepare waste reservoir
steps.instruction: Set up the trash as a waste reservoir for supernatant removal; this protocol uses a full 96‑sample plate and well 11 of the reservoir will receive the pooled samples.

steps.title: Add indexed oligo-dT
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of uniquely indexed oligo‑dT (25 µM) to each well of the 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Incubate and chill plate
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at 72 °C for 10 min, then place the plate on ice.

steps.title: Add Smart‑seq3 RT mix
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL of Smart‑seq3 RT mix to each well (final composition per well: 62.5 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.3, 75 mM NaCl, 6.25 mM MgCl₂, 2.5 mM GTP, 20 mM DTT, 1.25 U/µL RNase inhibitor, 5 U/µL Maxima H‑minus RT enzyme).

steps.title: Thermocycler incubation
steps.instruction: Place the plate in a thermocycler (off‑deck) for the reverse‑transcription incubation as specified in the Smart‑seq3 protocol.

steps.title: Add wash‑resuspension buffer
steps.instruction: After the RT reaction, add 60 µL of wash‑resuspension buffer to each well.

steps.title: Pool wells and wash columns (repeat 3×)
steps.instruction: Pool the contents column‑by‑column into a single reagent reservoir, washing each column with wash‑resuspension buffer as described, and repeat the whole process three times total.

substeps.instruction: Pool all wells into the reagent reservoir column by column.
For the first 8‑well column, add 100 µL wash‑resuspension buffer, pipette up and down, then dispense 50 µL of cell suspension into the reservoir.
Transfer the remaining ~100 µL from that well to the next well in the column.
Repeat the wash‑and‑transfer steps for each subsequent column.
For the final column, transfer the entire remaining volume to the reservoir.
Repeat the entire column‑pooling and washing procedure two additional times (three washes total).

steps.title: Transfer suspension to LoBind tube
steps.instruction: Move the pooled cell‑suspension mixture from the reagent reservoir into a 2 mL LoBind tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge cells
steps.instruction: Spin the tube at 800 g for 6 min.

steps.title: Wash cells and aspirate
steps.instruction: Wash the cell pellet once with 500 µL PBS + 0.04 % BSA, spin again at 800 g for 6 min, and aspirate the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend residual volume and strip transfer
steps.instruction: Measure the residual liquid volume in the Eppendorf tube, resuspend the cells with that volume, and transfer the entire solution into one tube of an 8‑tube strip. Then wash the Eppendorf tube with (80 µL – residual volume) of PBS + 0.04 % BSA and transfer this wash into the same strip tube.
